as_told.title: Friend's account of back-engineered and flown craft

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025 about a friend of his from the Air Force Academy, the school that trains Air Force officers. Salas says this friend told him, about ten years after they graduated, that he had flown a craft similar to a UFO. Because of this, Salas says he is convinced the US has back-engineered recovered craft, meaning studied them and built copies, and has even flown some models, which if true would mean the government holds and uses technology that humans did not invent.
